title: Unitarity constraints on 2HDM with higher dimensional operators
summary: We study how the requirement of perturbative unitarity restricts the parameter space of the two-Higgs-doublet model (2HDM) when higher-dimensional operators up to dimension six are included. We demonstrate that such operators can enhance scalar production cross sections in vector boson fusion relative to 2HDM. Using S-matrix unitarity, we place bounds on several dimension-six bosonic operators.
